components-alert.description: UBS Design System Alert component. RAG (Red/Amber/Green) status indicator following UBS brand guidelines: - Error: RAG Red (#BD000C) — critical problems - Warning: RAG Amber (#E4A911) — needs attention - Success: RAG Green (#6F7A1A) — on track - Info: Gray IV (#7A7870) — neutral information Meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements. Does not rely on colour alone (uses icons + text).

reactDocgen.description:
UBS Design System Alert component.

RAG (Red/Amber/Green) status indicator following UBS brand guidelines:
- Error: RAG Red (#BD000C) — critical problems
- Warning: RAG Amber (#E4A911) — needs attention
- Success: RAG Green (#6F7A1A) — on track
- Info: Gray IV (#7A7870) — neutral information

Meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements.
Does not rely on colour alone (uses icons + text).

@example
```tsx
<Alert variant="error" title="Transaction Failed">
  Please check your account details and try again.
</Alert>

<Alert variant="success" dismissible onDismiss={() => setShow(false)}>
  Your transfer has been completed successfully.
</Alert>
```

dismissible.description: Whether the alert can be dismissed. @default false

onDismiss.description: Callback fired when the alert is dismissed.

components-typography.description: UBS Design System Typography component. Implements the complete UBS 16-level type hierarchy with brand enforcement: - Font: Frutiger (fallback Arial) - Weights: light (300), roman (400), bold (700) - Red is never applied to numbers (dev warning) - No text shadows, no justified or right-aligned text - WCAG 2.2 AA contrast compliant

reactDocgen.description:
UBS Design System Typography component.

Implements the complete UBS 16-level type hierarchy with brand enforcement:
- Font: Frutiger (fallback Arial)
- Weights: light (300), roman (400), bold (700)
- Red is never applied to numbers (dev warning)
- No text shadows, no justified or right-aligned text
- WCAG 2.2 AA contrast compliant

@example
```tsx
<Typography variant="keyline">Welcome to UBS</Typography>
<Typography variant="copyText" weight="bold">Important notice</Typography>
<Typography variant="quotes" as="p" colour="#404040">
  "Excellence in everything we do."
</Typography>
```

variant.description: Typography variant from the UBS type hierarchy. @default 'copyText'

as.description: Polymorphic element to render as. Defaults based on variant.

colour.description: Text colour. Must be a valid CSS colour value. UBS Red must NOT be used for numbers.

weight.description: Font weight: 300 (light), 400 (roman), 700 (bold). Overrides the variant default.
